video_title: What should Ja Morant's role be with the Blazers⁉️ + Takeaways from Kessler's L.A. debut | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler's defensive impact for the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: his biggest impact is going to be defensively. JJ needs to preach constantly to him about winning
quotes.quote: His biggest impact is going to be defensively. JJ needs to preach constantly to him about winning defensive player of the year. That type of impact. I know it's hard because you have Wembanyama lurking out there, but because of their lack of perimeter defense and how long and athletic he is, he has to be the ultimate rim protector, rebounder, and be great in the pick and roll.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick's challenge to improve the Lakers' defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: JJ Redick has to start cracking the code of this Los Angeles Lakers defense

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: JJ Redick has to start cracking the code of this Los Angeles Lakers defense. During the bubble when they won their championship, they were a top defensive team. The year after, they were number one in defense. Under JJ, they were last last year, 17th the two years prior to that. He's been there for three or so years. They have to improve on that side.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: It has to be a complete defensive effort and not just one man in the middle trying to do your man's work.

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' potential starting lineup and defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: I think defensively, three, four and five right now, that will give you that identity
quotes.quote: I think defensively, three, four and five right now, that will give you that identity that Chiney was talking about. And again, accountability has to take place. People can't just start licking their fingers and thinking that it's going to be sweet every time they see Luka and Austin Reaves.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's need to earn his starting role in Portland
quotes.excerpt: Ja got to earn his way again. You are joining a team that has their core group
quotes.quote: Ja got to earn his way again. You are joining a team that has their core group along with their legend in Damian Lillard. Ja got to earn his way again. Fit-wise, I think Jrue Holiday and Damian Lillard is probably the better fit defensively. Jrue Holiday can kind of cover up some weaknesses here. I think for me, it's the interesting who's going to close the games.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's transition to a new system in Portland
quotes.excerpt: the system was where things sort of went wrong in Memphis. Trying to acclimate to that
quotes.quote: The system was where things sort of went wrong in Memphis. Trying to acclimate to that new system and also he was not really attacking the rim the way we normally saw and the three point shooting was a question. So he can ease himself into this new system.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's return and role alongside Cooper Flagg
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie's return does not mean that Cooper Flagg will have the ball in his hands less often
quotes.quote: Kyrie looked like Kyrie. He looked like an eight-time All-Star. Dusty May made it clear that Kyrie's return does not mean that Cooper Flagg will have the ball in his hands less often. He'll just have the ball in his hands in better situations. Kyrie clearly is proving he can play with other stars. Now it's going to be Cooper Flagg. He can play on the ball, off the ball, he can create an advantage, he can space the floor.

quotes.speaker: Michael C. Wright
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' commitment to a three-guard starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: it is not a matter of if those three guards will all start together, it's a matter of when
quotes.quote: It is not a matter of if those three guards will all start together, it's a matter of when. Mitch Johnson, head coach of the Spurs, he sort of shocked all of us during his pregame remarks going into the preseason opener. He straight up said that he was going to start those three guards. Billy Donovan has been a big part of these three guards all working together on the floor together. He's been working with them on spacing, on just making sure that they all don't step on each other's toes. De'Aaron Fox said that Billy Donovan has really talked to them a lot about his experiences in OKC where he had a trio of dynamic guards in Dennis Schroder, CP3, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. They think that this thing could really work in San Antonio and they're going to give it a try.
